admitted.explain: Zeroshot accepted the run and is preparing it.
admitted.label: Starting

running.explain: Agents are working on this run right now.
running.label: Running

stalled.explain: The run says it is running, but its controller process is gone.
stalled.label: Stalled

stopping.explain: A stop was requested; Zeroshot is winding the run down.
stopping.label: Stopping

succeeded.explain: The graph reached a succeed exit.
succeeded.label: Succeeded

suspended.explain: Paused at a checkpoint: it continues when it is resumed or its question is answered.
suspended.label: Suspended

unknown.explain: zerochat could not tell what state this run is in.
unknown.label: Unknown
